name: AO SMITH U2+
summary: The A.O. Smith U2 Pro+ is a compact under-the-sink UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply. Featuring Next-Gen UVC LED , TwinPure™ Technology , and a Copper Mineraliser , it delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.
intro: The A.O. Smith U2 Pro+ is a premium under-the-sink UV water purifier designed for modern kitchens. Powered by Next-Gen UVC LED and TwinPure™ Technology, it passes water twice through the UV chamber for enhanced purification. The built-in Copper Mineraliser enriches water with copper, while the 6-litre storage tank ensures purified water is always available. Ideal for municipal corporation water with TDS up to 250 ppm, the U2 Pro+ combines compact design, advanced purification, and a stylish gooseneck faucet.
